defect_note: No bridge defect was found within the validation scope, so no production code was modified. Two pre-existing, out-of-scope observations were recorded rather than changed: (1) remote_queue/poller.py:197-212 routes task ids containing 'bridge-validation'/'operational'/'e2e' to hardcoded stub handlers that return fabricated 'completed' payloads with no execution evidence (already recorded as a deliberately unfixed defect in state/current_company_state.md:170-172); the validated task id does not match any of those patterns and was correctly dispatched to dispatch_task. (2) _terminate_child_tree returns after taskkill without checking its return code, so its documented terminate()/kill() fallback is only reachable when taskkill raises; the watchdog retries once per second and the 1200s hard bound is the outer backstop.
